snapshot.baseline: Proposed durable work and outbox contract

records.name: Plan generation
records.deduplication: actor plus Idempotency-Key and request hash
records.lease: Required with heartbeat and attempt limit
records.terminal_result: READY plan id/revision or stable failure code
records.notes: The latest owner-scoped job for an authoritative profile-local day, including terminal jobs, is readable for cold-start recovery. Only an explicit POST creates a job.

records.name: Selected plan-variant replacement command
records.deduplication: Plan mutation Idempotency-Key and request hash
records.lease: Not applicable: deterministic local selection commits synchronously
records.notes: This is not AI generation and has no worker/provider call. Provider-backed replacement is a separate pending workflow.

records.name: Conversation response generation
records.deduplication: durable response_job_id metadata plus deterministic assistant client id
records.terminal_result: Atomically persisted assistant message or stable failure code
records.notes: Bounded runner, Gemini adapter, and combined plan/conversation worker composition are implemented. Owner/clinical staging approval and live provider verification remain pending.

records.name: Account export
records.terminal_result: Time-limited private encrypted object reference and manifest checksum; job result has no URL or payload
records.notes: The single worker process has a job-type-filtered export lane using the canonical AES-GCM builder and private Supabase adapter. Credential rotation, production private-bucket policy and isolated staging proof remain required.

records.name: Complete account deletion
records.terminal_result: Deletion verification receipt without health content
records.notes: The single worker process has a job-type-filtered deletion lane. It remains fail-closed unless the non-secret API/runtime enablement flag, complete worker credentials and owner/legal approval reference are all configured. The checkpoint eraser recognizes only the pinned public LangGraph layout and user:{uuid}: thread namespace; global checkpoint_migrations is retained. Credential rotation, private-bucket verification, legal retention decision and isolated live proof remain required before activation.

records.name: Outbox publication
records.deduplication: At-least-once delivery; every consumer durably deduplicates on outbox event id
records.lease: PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED lease with heartbeat, expiry recovery and bounded attempts
records.notes: Deliberately excluded from the combined Render worker: only a deterministic test publisher exists. An approved production event-bus publisher, destination credentials, consumer deduplication proof, and staging delivery verification are required before composition.

records.name: plan.ready.v1
records.payload: event id, plan id, revision, user id, local date, occurred_at; no health answers

records.name: action-item.event-recorded.v1
records.payload: event id, item id, user id, event type, local date, occurred_at

records.name: daily-review.recorded.v1
records.payload: review id, plan id, user id, local date, occurred_at; no answer text
records.notes: Streak adjudication and any earned-day grant are committed inline from the normalized review; no outbox event is emitted in this slice.

records.name: account.deletion-requested.v1
records.payload: deletion job id and deletion request id; owner relation is erased with the account
